rule_metadata.description: The complete merging of a vowelless Meem (مْ) into a succeeding vowelled Meem (م) across words, accompanied by a 2-count nasal Ghunnah.

theoretical_foundation.linguistic_definition: Idgham means merging, and Shafawi means labial. It is also classified as 'Al-Mithlayn As-Saghir' (the two identical letters, small form) because a Saakin Meem meets a Mutaharrik Meem.
theoretical_foundation.applied_tajweed_definition: When a non-vowelled Meem (مْ) is followed by another vowelled Meem (م) across two words, they merge into one Meem with a Shaddah, held with a 2-count nasal resonance (Ghunnah).

trigger_letter.name: Meem
trigger_letter.mechanism: The lips close firmly and completely for the duration of the Shaddah while sustaining the nasal hum.

theoretical_foundation.mushaf_indicator: The first Meem is written bare (no sukoon), and the second Meem carries a Shaddah (Tashdeed).

practical_examples.breakdown: The Meem Sakinah of 'Lahum' merges fully into the Meem of 'ma' with a 2-count Ghunnah.
Complete labial merging of Meem into Meem with a held nasal resonance.

assessment_bank.question: What is another name for Idgham Shafawi based on letter relationships?
options: Al-Mithlayn As-Saghir (The two identical letters - small)

assessment_bank.question: Which letter triggers Idgham Shafawi when following Meem Sakinah?
How many counts of Ghunnah are required during Idgham Shafawi?
What happens to the two Meems when Idgham Shafawi occurs?
options: They merge completely into a single Meem with a Shaddah
They are pronounced separately with a pause
The first Meem changes to a Noon

assessment_bank.question: In 'لَهُمْ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ', how is the transition between 'لَهُمْ' and 'مَا' performed?
options: Merged into one doubled Meem with a 2-count nasal hum
Read as two distinct separate Meems

assessment_bank.question: What is the visual indicator of Idgham Shafawi in standard Mushafs?
options: First Meem is bare, second Meem has a Shaddah
First Meem has a small Meem sign

assessment_bank.question: Does Idgham Shafawi occur across two words or within a single word?
options: Only at the beginning of Surahs

assessment_bank.question: In 'وَلَهُمْ مَاعَذَابٌ', what rule applies between the Meems?
What error is committed if a reciter reads 'لَهُمْ مَا' without holding the nasal Ghunnah?
options: Failed to sustain the mandatory 2-count nasal resonance for merged Meem

assessment_bank.question: Summarize the execution of Idgham Shafawi:
options: Encounter vowelless Meem + vowelled Meem -> merge fully into one doubled Meem -> hold 2-count nasal Ghunnah
Read clear Meem -> pause -> read second Meem
